title: Zesty Peruvian Potato Wrap
description: A flavorful and textured Peruvian dish featuring potatoes, cultured creme fraiche, and score fat, all wrapped in a lotus leaf, making it a unique ovo-vegetarian friendly option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper, and toss to coat.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the potatoes are roasting, prepare the lotus leaves by rinsing them in cold water and cutting off the stems.
In a small bowl, mix together the cultured creme fraiche, score fat, lime juice, and chopped cilantro.

Once the potatoes are done, let them cool slightly, then assemble the wraps by spooning the potato mixture onto a lotus leaf, followed by a dollop of the creme fraiche mixture and a few slices of red onion.
Fold the lotus leaf over the filling to form a tight package, and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional cilantro and lime wedges, if desired.
Repeat the assembly process with the remaining ingredients.
